hook: Indian Roads Congress brings its *85th* session to HITEX, Nov 19-22
hook_b: Indian Roads Congress brings its *85th* session to HITEX, Nov 19-22
tldr: The Indian Roads Congress (IRC) will hold its 85th Annual Session at the HITEX Exhibition Centre from November 19 to 22.

beats.what: Engineers, researchers, students, contractors, consultants, manufacturers and government departments will discuss the future of India's roads and highways.
beats.why: It also hosts IRC's key meetings: the 238th Council Meeting (Nov 19), the 90th Highway Research Board meeting (Nov 20) and the Business Meeting (Nov 21).
beats.care: The session ends on November 22 with the 239th Council Meeting, delegate tours and a technical site visit.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Roads and Buildings Minister Komatireddy Venkat Reddy called it a matter of pride for Telangana to host the event.

cards.q: What should India's road engineers fix first in Hyderabad?

qs: Will any Hyderabad road project be shown at the technical site visit?

facts.t: The Highway Research Board meets for the *90th* time on Nov 20 at the session.

viz.verdict: Four days of national road meetings in Hyderabad

learn.t: IRC = Indian Roads Congress, the body that sets road design standards in India

watch: Whether Hyderabad traffic police issue advisories around HITEX for November 19-22.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Indian Roads Congress to hold 85th Annual Session in Hyderabad

fact: India's road engineers meet at HITEX for the *85th* Indian Roads Congress, Nov 19-22
twist: Members will also vote to elect the IRC's Council during the Hyderabad session.
